SIGNALS.name: Anthropic
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic says it priced its IPO at $83 per share, with trading on Nasdaq expected to begin on November 19. The SEC declared the registration effective on November 18.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI shares new data on AI's role in its own research: researchers' AI use keeps rising and agents finish longer tasks, while humans stay central and spend more time on safety work.

SIGNALS.name: Artificial Analysis
SIGNALS.summary: With Antigravity CLI, Gemini 4 Neon (xhigh) scores 59 on the Coding Agent Index, ahead of Carbon (55) and in line with Claude Code on Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 (58), at lower cost.

SIGNALS.name: Google DeepMind
SIGNALS.summary: Google DeepMind begins rolling out Gemini 4 Neon, positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen, for software engineering, knowledge work and science tasks.

SIGNALS.name: Reuters
SIGNALS.summary: Reuters reports that Anthropic's IPO is expected to make thousands of its employees and holders millionaires.

SIGNALS.name: Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google makes Genie 4, a world model from DeepMind, available in Project Genie. It lets users edit environments mid-session with text prompts, with real-time audio and dialogue.

SIGNALS.name: Tencent 腾讯
SIGNALS.summary: Tencent says Hy4 flash is live on its TokenHub, WorkBuddy and Yuanbao. It is natively multimodal, has a 1M-token context window and decodes at over 150 tokens per second.

SIGNALS.name: NVIDIA AI Infrastructure
SIGNALS.summary: NVIDIA introduced Rubin HPC, a GPU in the Vera Rubin platform aimed at simulation and data processing for science, engineering and analytics work.
